The '''Bait Maker''' is a piece of [[Crafting#Refining Equipment|Refining Equipment]] that is used to create [[Targeted Bait]] from any [[fish]]. It takes {{duration|10m|class=inline}} to process fish into bait. It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] after reaching [[Fishing]] Level 6.

To use, insert any fish into the machine. It will then produce 5-10 "[fish name] Bait," which will increase the chance of catching that fish when attached. Any fish can be used, including [[Fish#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]] (which cannot be caught more than once per save file) and [[Fish#Crab Pot Fish|Crab Pot Fish]]. However, catchable items such as [[Seaweed]], Algae, and Jelly cannot be put into the Bait Maker.
